title: SkillMarker: A KGW-Based Watermarking Method for Agent Skill Ownership Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.15725v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent skills encode operational procedures and domain expertise as reusable knowledge assets, yet their distribution in plaintext exposes them to unauthorized copying and leakage. However, practical mechanisms for skill ownership verification and leakage tracing remain underdeveloped. Watermark embedding before distribution offers a potential solution, but structured, compact skill instructions impose stringent requirements for factual and procedural accuracy. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillMarker, a KGW-based watermarking method that jointly targets functionality preservation and strong watermark embedding. SkillMarker unifies quality-constrained rewriting with signal-oriented candidate search. The former separates essential knowledge from flexible expression to preserve instruction fidelity; the latter explores alternative expressions to obtain a stronger watermark signal under preservation constraints. translated_title: SkillMarker：一种基于KGW的智能体技能所有权验证水印方法
translated_abstract: 智能体技能将操作流程和领域专业知识编码为可复用的知识资产，然而其以明文形式分发使其面临未经授权的复制和泄露风险。然而，用于技能所有权验证和泄露溯源的实用机制仍然发展不足。在分发前嵌入水印提供了一种潜在的解决方案，但结构化、紧凑的技能指令对事实和程序的准确性提出了严格要求。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SkillMarker，一种基于KGW的水印方法，旨在同时实现功能保留和强水印嵌入。SkillMarker将质量约束重写与面向信号的候选搜索统一起来。前者将核心知识与灵活表达分离以保持指令的忠实性；后者在保留约束下探索替代表达以获得更强的水印信号。
tldr: SkillMarker是一种基于KGW的智能体技能水印方法，通过质量约束重写保留技能指令的功能准确性，同时利用面向信号的候选搜索嵌入强水印，实现技能所有权验证与泄露溯源。
en_tdlr: SkillMarker is a KGW-based watermarking method for agent skills that preserves instruction fidelity through quality-constrained rewriting while embedding strong watermarks via signal-oriented candidate search, enabling skill ownership verification and leakage tracing.
